--!strict
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Knit = require(RS.Packages.Knit)
local Garden = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.Definitions.GardenDefinitions)
local PetDefs = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.Definitions.PetDefinitions)
local Variants = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.Definitions.VariantDefinitions)
local PetMath = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.PetMath)
local Guard = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utilities.GameplayGuard)

local Service = Knit.CreateService({ Name = "GardenExpeditionService", Client = {} })
local Data: any = nil
local returnSpots: { [Player]: CFrame } = {}
local claimLocks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local REALM_CENTER = Vector3.new(2000, 30, 2000)

local function expeditions(data: any): { any }
	if type(data.GardenExpeditions) ~= "table" then data.GardenExpeditions = {} end
	return data.GardenExpeditions
end

local function cosmetics(data: any): { [string]: boolean }
	if type(data.GardenCosmetics) ~= "table" then data.GardenCosmetics = {} end
	return data.GardenCosmetics
end

local function findExpedition(data: any, uid: string): (any, number)
	for i, entry in ipairs(expeditions(data)) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and entry.UID == uid then return entry, i end
	end
	return nil, 0
end

local function mutationPower(pet: any): number
	local entry = Variants.Mutations[pet.Mutation]
	return (entry and entry.Power) or 1
end

local function fullReward(pet: any, durationSeconds: number): number
	local def = PetDefs[pet.PetId]
	local rarity = def and def.Rarity or "Common"
	return Garden.Estimate(rarity, pet.Level or 1, mutationPower(pet), pet.Shiny == true, pet.Prismatic == true, durationSeconds)
end

local function grantPetXP(player: Player, data: any, pet: any, amount: number)
	if amount <= 0 or pet.Level >= Variants.MaxLevel then return false end
	pet.XP += amount
	local leveled = false
	while pet.Level < Variants.MaxLevel and pet.XP >= PetMath.RequiredXP(pet.Level) do
		pet.XP -= PetMath.RequiredXP(pet.Level)
		pet.Level += 1
		leveled = true
	end
	if pet.Level >= Variants.MaxLevel then pet.XP = 0 end
	return leveled
end

function Service:Start(player: Player, uid: string, durationId: string): (boolean, any)
	if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) or not Guard.Id(uid) or not Guard.Id(durationId) then return false, "Invalid expedition" end
	local duration = Garden.Durations[durationId]
	if not duration then return false, "Unknown expedition length" end
	local data = Data:Get(player)
	if not data then return false, "Profile is loading" end
	local pets = Knit.GetService("PetService")
	local pet, petIndex = pets:FindOwned(data, uid)
	if not pet then return false, "Pet unavailable" end
 if findExpedition(data, uid) ~= nil then return false, "This pet is already foraging." end
 if #expeditions(data) >= Garden.MaxActive then return false, "All 3 Garden plots are occupied." end
 if table.find(data.EquippedPets, uid) ~= nil then return false, "Unequip this pet before sending it." end
 local def = PetDefs[pet.PetId]
 if not def then return false, "Pet unavailable" end
 local now = os.time()
 table.insert(expeditions(data), {
  TripId = Http:GenerateGUID(false),
  UID = uid,
		PetId = pet.PetId,
		DurationId = durationId,
		Duration = duration.Seconds,
		StartedAt = now,
		ReadyAt = now + duration.Seconds,
	})
 Data:Publish(player, "GardenExpeditions")
 print("[Garden] Start", player.Name, pet.PetId, durationId)
 return true, { Kind = "GardenStarted", PetId = pet.PetId, DisplayName = def.DisplayName, DurationId = durationId, DurationLabel = duration.Label }
end

function Service:Claim(player: Player, uid: string): (boolean, any)
 if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) or not Guard.Id(uid) then return false, "Invalid claim" end
 if claimLocks[player] then return false, "Claim already in progress" end
 claimLocks[player] = true
 local ok, success, result = pcall(function()
  return self:ClaimInternal(player, uid)
 end)
 claimLocks[player] = nil
 if not ok then warn("[Garden] Claim error " .. tostring(success)); return false, "Action unavailable; please try again" end
 return success, result
end

function Service:ClaimInternal(player: Player, uid: string): (boolean, any)
	if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) or not Guard.Id(uid) then return false, "Invalid claim" end
	local data = Data:Get(player)
	if not data then return false, "Profile is loading" end
 local entry, index = findExpedition(data, uid)
 if not entry then return false, "That expedition has already been claimed." end
 local now = os.time()
 if now < entry.ReadyAt then
  return false, "Still foraging (" .. tostring(entry.ReadyAt - now) .. "s left)"
 end
	local pets = Knit.GetService("PetService")
	local pet, petIndex = pets:FindOwned(data, uid)
	if not pet then
		table.remove(expeditions(data), index)
		Data:Publish(player, "GardenExpeditions")
		return false, "Pet is gone; expedition cleared"
	end
	local amount = fullReward(pet, entry.Duration)
	local jitter = 0.9 + ((now + #pet.PetId) % 20) / 100
	amount = math.max(1, math.floor(amount * jitter))
	table.remove(expeditions(data), index)
	local economy = Knit.GetService("EconomyService")
	economy:Add(player, Garden.Currency, amount, "Garden")
	grantPetXP(player, data, pet, math.floor(entry.Duration / 60 * 10))
	pets:Publish(player)
	Data:Publish(player, "GardenExpeditions")
	local crops = Garden.SplitCrops(amount, now % 997)
	print("[Garden] Claim", player.Name, pet.PetId, amount)
	return true, { Kind = "GardenClaim", Amount = amount, Crops = crops, PetId = pet.PetId }
end

function Service:Cancel(player: Player, uid: string): (boolean, any)
	if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) or not Guard.Id(uid) then return false, "Invalid expedition" end
	local data = Data:Get(player)
	if not data then return false, "Profile is loading" end
	local entry, index = findExpedition(data, uid)
	if not entry then return false, "No expedition found" end
	local now = os.time()
	local elapsed = math.max(0, now - (entry.StartedAt or now))
	table.remove(expeditions(data), index)
	local partial = 0
	if elapsed >= 20 then
		local pets = Knit.GetService("PetService")
		local pet = pets:FindOwned(data, uid)
		if pet then
			partial = math.floor(fullReward(pet, entry.Duration) * (math.min(elapsed, entry.Duration) / entry.Duration) * 0.5)
		end
	end
	if partial > 0 then
		Knit.GetService("EconomyService"):Add(player, Garden.Currency, partial, "GardenRecall")
	end
 Data:Publish(player, "GardenExpeditions")
 print("[Garden] Cancel", player.Name, uid, partial)
 if partial > 0 then return true, "Pet recalled with +" .. tostring(partial) .. " Harvest" end
 return true, "Pet recalled from the garden"
end

function Service:ClaimAll(player: Player): (boolean, any)
 if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) then return false, "Invalid claim" end
 if claimLocks[player] then return false, "Claim already in progress" end
 claimLocks[player] = true
 local ok, success, result = pcall(function()
  local data = Data:Get(player)
  if not data then return false, "Profile is loading" end
  local now = os.time()
  local ready: { string } = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(expeditions(data)) do
   if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.UID) == "string" and now >= (entry.ReadyAt or math.huge) then
    table.insert(ready, entry.UID)
   end
  end
  if #ready == 0 then return false, "No finished expeditions to claim." end
  local total = 0
  local claims: { any } = {}
  for _, uid in ipairs(ready) do
   local done, res = self:ClaimInternal(player, uid)
   if done and type(res) == "table" then
    total += (res.Amount or 0)
    table.insert(claims, res)
   end
  end
  if total <= 0 then return false, "That expedition has already been claimed." end
  return true, { Kind = "GardenClaimAll", Amount = total, Claims = claims }
 end)
 claimLocks[player] = nil
 if not ok then warn("[Garden] ClaimAll error " .. tostring(success)); return false, "Action unavailable; please try again" end
 return success, result
end

local function gardenArrival(): (Vector3, Vector3)
 local realm = workspace:FindFirstChild("PetGardenRealm")
 local marker = realm and realm:FindFirstChild("GardenArrival", true)
 if marker and marker:IsA("BasePart") then
  return marker.Position, REALM_CENTER
 end
 return REALM_CENTER + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 48), REALM_CENTER
end

local function safeGround(position: Vector3, character: Model?): Vector3?
 local ray = RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 local filter: { Instance } = { workspace:FindFirstChild("BiomeTeleportPoints") }
 if character then table.insert(filter, character) end
 local realm = workspace:FindFirstChild("PetGardenRealm")
 if realm then table.insert(filter, realm) end
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
 ray.IgnoreWater = true
 local hit = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), ray)
 if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide then
  return hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
 end
 return nil
end

function Service:VisitGarden(player: Player): (boolean, any)
 if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) then return false, "Invalid request" end
 local root = Guard.Alive(player)
 if not root then return false, "Respawn first" end
 local character = player.Character
 local realm = workspace:FindFirstChild("PetGardenRealm")
 if not realm then return false, "Garden is unavailable" end
 if (root.Position - REALM_CENTER).Magnitude < 90 then return false, "You are already in the garden." end
 if claimLocks[player] then return false, "Please wait a moment" end
 returnSpots[player] = root.CFrame
 local marker = realm:FindFirstChild("GardenArrival", true)
 local dest: Vector3
 if marker and marker:IsA("BasePart") then
  dest = marker.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
 else
  dest = REALM_CENTER + Vector3.new(0, 2, 48)
 end
 local facing = REALM_CENTER - dest
 character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(dest, dest + Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)))
 local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if humanoid then
  local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
 end
 print("[Garden] Visit", player.Name)
 return true, { Kind = "GardenVisit" }
end

function Service:ReturnToKingdom(player: Player): (boolean, any)
 if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) then return false, "Invalid request" end
 local root = Guard.Alive(player)
 if not root then returnSpots[player] = nil; return false, "Respawn first" end
 local character = player.Character
 local saved = returnSpots[player]
 returnSpots[player] = nil
 local dest: Vector3? = nil
 if saved then
  local pos = saved.Position
  if (pos - REALM_CENTER).Magnitude > 90 and math.abs(pos.Y) < 600 and pos.Magnitude < 12000 then
   dest = safeGround(pos, character) or pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
  end
 end
 if not dest then
  local plot = Knit.GetService("PlotService"):GetPlot(player)
  local spawnPart: BasePart? = nil
  if plot then spawnPart = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSpawn", true) or plot:FindFirstChild("Plot1Spawn", true) end
  if spawnPart and spawnPart:IsA("BasePart") then
   dest = spawnPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
  else
   local markers = workspace:FindFirstChild("BiomeTeleportPoints")
   local meadow = markers and markers:FindFirstChild("Meadow")
   if meadow and meadow:IsA("BasePart") then
    dest = meadow.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
   else
    local anySpawn = workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
    if anySpawn then dest = (anySpawn :: BasePart).Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) end
   end
  end
 end
 if not dest then return false, "Return unavailable" end
 local look = saved and (saved.LookVector.X * Vector3.xAxis + saved.LookVector.Z * Vector3.zAxis) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
 if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
 character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(dest, dest + look))
 print("[Garden] Return", player.Name)
 return true, { Kind = "GardenReturn" }
end

function Service:BuyCosmetic(player: Player, cosmeticId: string): (boolean, any)
	if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) or not Guard.Id(cosmeticId) then return false, "Invalid cosmetic" end
	local def = Garden.Cosmetics[cosmeticId]
	if not def then return false, "Unknown cosmetic" end
	local data = Data:Get(player)
	if not data then return false, "Profile is loading" end
	if cosmetics(data)[cosmeticId] then return false, "Already owned" end
 if not Knit.GetService("EconomyService"):Spend(player, Garden.Currency, def.Cost, "GardenCosmetic") then
  return false, "Not enough Harvest."
 end
	cosmetics(data)[cosmeticId] = true
	Data:Publish(player, "GardenCosmetics")
	print("[Garden] BuyCosmetic", player.Name, cosmeticId)
	return true, def.DisplayName .. " unlocked!"
end

function Service:EquipCosmetic(player: Player, uid: string, cosmeticId: string): (boolean, any)
	if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) or not Guard.Id(uid) or type(cosmeticId) ~= "string" or #cosmeticId > 40 then
		return false, "Invalid cosmetic"
	end
	local data = Data:Get(player)
	if not data then return false, "Profile is loading" end
	local pets = Knit.GetService("PetService")
	local pet = pets:FindOwned(data, uid)
	if not pet then return false, "Pet unavailable" end
	if cosmeticId == "None" or cosmeticId == "" then
		pet.Cosmetic = nil
	else
		if not Garden.Cosmetics[cosmeticId] then return false, "Unknown cosmetic" end
		if not cosmetics(data)[cosmeticId] then return false, "Unlock it with Harvest first" end
		pet.Cosmetic = cosmeticId
	end
	pets:Publish(player)
	print("[Garden] EquipCosmetic", player.Name, pet.PetId, cosmeticId)
	if cosmeticId == "None" or cosmeticId == "" then return true, "Cosmetic removed" end
	return true, Garden.Cosmetics[cosmeticId].DisplayName .. " dressed up!"
end

function Service:KnitInit()
 Data = Knit.GetService("PlayerDataService")
end

function Service:KnitStart()
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
  returnSpots[player] = nil
  claimLocks[player] = nil
 end)
end

return Service

--!strict
-- Garden expedition tuning. Single source of truth for server + client preview.
local Garden = {}

Garden.MaxActive = 3
Garden.Currency = "GardenHarvest"

Garden.Durations = {
	SproutRun = { Id = "SproutRun", DisplayName = "Sprout Run", Seconds = 60, Label = "1 min" },
	GardenShift = { Id = "GardenShift", DisplayName = "Garden Shift", Seconds = 300, Label = "5 min" },
	GrandHarvest = { Id = "GrandHarvest", DisplayName = "Grand Harvest", Seconds = 900, Label = "15 min" },
}
Garden.DurationOrder = { "SproutRun", "GardenShift", "GrandHarvest" }

Garden.TripDisplay = {
 SproutRun = { Tagline = "Quick expedition", BaseLabel = "Low", BestFor = "fast farming" },
 GardenShift = { Tagline = "Balanced expedition", BaseLabel = "Medium", BestFor = "steady harvest" },
 GrandHarvest = { Tagline = "Long expedition", BaseLabel = "High", BestFor = "big hauls" },
}

Garden.RealmCenter = Vector3.new(2000, 30, 2000)

Garden.RarityMultiplier = {
	Common = 1,
	Uncommon = 1.5,
	Rare = 2.2,
	Epic = 3.2,
	Legendary = 5,
	Mythical = 8,
	Secret = 12,
}

Garden.CropNames = { "Carrot", "Tomato", "Pumpkin", "Starberry", "Moonmelon" }

Garden.Cosmetics = {
	FlowerCrown = { Id = "FlowerCrown", DisplayName = "Flower Crown", Cost = 40, Description = "A ring of garden blooms." },
	StrawberryHat = { Id = "StrawberryHat", DisplayName = "Strawberry Hat", Cost = 90, Description = "Freshly picked berry cap." },
	LeafyAura = { Id = "LeafyAura", DisplayName = "Leafy Aura", Cost = 150, Description = "Swirling garden leaves." },
	GoldenBloom = { Id = "GoldenBloom", DisplayName = "Golden Bloom", Cost = 300, Description = "A radiant golden harvest glow." },
	RainbowSprout = { Id = "RainbowSprout", DisplayName = "Rainbow Sprout", Cost = 500, Description = "The garden's rarest shimmer." },
}
Garden.CosmeticOrder = { "FlowerCrown", "StrawberryHat", "LeafyAura", "GoldenBloom", "RainbowSprout" }

function Garden.RarityMult(rarity: string): number
	return Garden.RarityMultiplier[rarity] or 1
end

function Garden.LevelMult(level: number): number
	return 1 + (math.max(1, level) - 1) * 0.03
end

-- Longer expeditions and higher rarity pets earn more. Deterministic preview.
function Garden.Estimate(rarity: string, level: number, mutationPower: number, shiny: boolean, prismatic: boolean, seconds: number): number
	local base = math.max(1, seconds) / 60 * 8
	local total = base * Garden.RarityMult(rarity) * Garden.LevelMult(level or 1) * (mutationPower or 1)
	if shiny then total *= 1.5 end
	if prismatic then total *= 2 end
	return math.max(1, math.floor(total))
end

-- Flavor split of a total harvest across crop names. Sums back to total.
function Garden.SplitCrops(total: number, seed: number): {{ Name: string, Amount: number }}
	local names = Garden.CropNames
	local parts = math.min(#names, 2 + (seed % 3))
	local remaining = total
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, parts do
		local amount = 0
		if i == parts then
			amount = remaining
		else
			amount = math.max(1, math.floor(total / parts * (0.7 + ((seed + i * 37) % 60) / 100)))
			amount = math.min(amount, remaining - (parts - i))
		end
		remaining -= amount
		table.insert(out, { Name = names[((seed + i - 1) % #names) + 1], Amount = amount })
	end
	return out
end

return table.freeze(Garden)
sources.StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Garde:
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local Knit = require(RS.Packages.Knit)
local Appearance = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.PetAppearance)

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local REALM_CENTER = Vector3.new(2000, 30, 2000)
local slots: { any } = {}
local butterflies: { BasePart } = {}
local dataSnapshot: any = nil

local function realm(): Model?
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("PetGardenRealm") :: any
end

local function getData(): any
	local ok, ctrl = pcall(function() return Knit.GetController("DataController") end)
	if not ok or not ctrl then return nil end
	local ok2, d = pcall(function() return (ctrl :: any):GetPlayerData() end)
	if not ok2 then return nil end
	return d
end

local function findPet(data: any, uid: string): any
	for _, p in ipairs(data.Pets or {}) do if p.UID == uid then return p end end
	return nil
end

local function ensureSlot(i: number): any
	if slots[i] then return slots[i] end
	local r = realm()
	if not r then return nil end
	local plot = r:FindFirstChild("GardenPlot" .. tostring(i))
	if not plot then return nil end
	local pad = plot:FindFirstChild("PetPad")
	local anchors: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(plot:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name:match("^CropAnchor") then table.insert(anchors, child) end
	end
	table.sort(anchors, function(a: BasePart, b: BasePart): boolean return a.Name < b.Name end)
	local folderVisuals = Instance.new("Folder")
	folderVisuals.Name = "WorkVisuals"
	folderVisuals.Parent = plot
	local crops: { BasePart } = {}
	for k, anchor in ipairs(anchors) do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "CropStage" .. tostring(k)
		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.8, 0.6)
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 120)
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(anchor.Position)
		part.Parent = folderVisuals
		table.insert(crops, part)
	end
	local bill = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bill.Name = "PlotStatus"
	bill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 64)
	bill.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	bill.AlwaysOnTop = false
	bill.MaxDistance = 90
	local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
	local adornee: Instance? = sign and sign:IsA("BasePart") and sign or pad
	if adornee then bill.Adornee = adornee end
	bill.Parent = plot
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "StatusText"
	text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	text.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 58, 49)
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	text.TextSize = 14
	text.TextWrapped = true
	text.Parent = bill
	local sparkAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
	sparkAttach.Name = "ReadySparkles"
	local padPart = pad and pad:IsA("BasePart") and pad or nil
	if padPart then
		sparkAttach.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		sparkAttach.Parent = padPart
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Name = "ReadyGlow"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 130))
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.16)
		emitter.LightEmission = 0.5
		emitter.Parent = sparkAttach
	end
	local slot = {
		Index = i,
		Plot = plot,
		Pad = pad,
		Crops = crops,
		Billboard = bill,
		StatusText = text,
		Visuals = folderVisuals,
		PetModel = nil :: any,
		PetUID = nil :: any,
		Seed = math.random() * 10,
	}
	slots[i] = slot
	return slot
end

local function setCrops(slot: any, frac: number, ready: boolean)
	local stage = 0
	if frac < 0.25 then stage = 0
	elseif frac < 0.5 then stage = 1
	elseif frac < 0.75 then stage = 2
	elseif frac < 1 then stage = 3
	else stage = 4 end
	for k, part in ipairs(slot.Crops) do
		local p = part :: BasePart
		if stage == 0 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.7, 0.4)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 130)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
		elseif stage == 1 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 1, 0.7)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 185, 105)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
		elseif stage == 2 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1.3, 1)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 150, 60)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		elseif stage == 3 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.4, 1.2)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 110, 60)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		else
			p.Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 1.5, 1.4)
			p.Color = (k % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(240, 140, 30) or Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 60)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		end
		p.Transparency = 0
	end
	local padPart = slot.Pad and slot.Pad:IsA("BasePart") and slot.Pad or nil
	if padPart then
		local attach = padPart:FindFirstChild("ReadySparkles")
		if attach then
			local emitter = attach:FindFirstChild("ReadyGlow")
			if emitter and emitter:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				emitter.Rate = ready and 4 or 0
			end
		end
	end
end

local function clearSlot(slot: any)
	if slot.PetModel then (slot.PetModel :: Model):Destroy() slot.PetModel = nil end
	slot.PetUID = nil
	for _, part in ipairs(slot.Crops) do (part :: BasePart).Transparency = 1 end
	local padPart = slot.Pad and slot.Pad:IsA("BasePart") and slot.Pad or nil
	if padPart then
		local attach = padPart:FindFirstChild("ReadySparkles")
		if attach then
			local emitter = attach:FindFirstChild("ReadyGlow")
			if emitter and emitter:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then emitter.Rate = 0 end
		end
	end
	slot.StatusText.Text = "EMPTY PLOT ➕"
end

local function refreshState()
	dataSnapshot = getData()
	local r = realm()
	if not r then return end
	local entries: { any } = {}
	if dataSnapshot and type(dataSnapshot.GardenExpeditions) == "table" then
		for _, e in ipairs(dataSnapshot.GardenExpeditions) do table.insert(entries, e) end
		table.sort(entries, function(a: any, b: any): boolean return (a.StartedAt or 0) < (b.StartedAt or 0) end)
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local slot = ensureSlot(i)
		if not slot then continue end
		local entry = entries[i]
		if not entry then
			if slot.PetUID ~= nil then clearSlot(slot) end
			slot.StatusText.Text = "EMPTY PLOT ➕"
			continue
		end
		local now = os.time()
		local duration = math.max(1, entry.Duration or 60)
		local left = math.max(0, (entry.ReadyAt or now) - now)
		local frac = math.clamp((duration - left) / duration, 0, 1)
		local ready = left <= 0
		setCrops(slot, frac, ready)
		local pet = dataSnapshot and findPet(dataSnapshot, entry.UID) or nil
		local wantKey = entry.UID .. "|" .. (pet and (pet.PetId .. tostring(pet.Cosmetic)) or "gone")
		if slot.PetUID ~= wantKey then
			if slot.PetModel then (slot.PetModel :: Model):Destroy() slot.PetModel = nil end
			if pet then
				local ok, model = pcall(function() return Appearance.Create(pet) end)
				if ok and model then
					(model :: Model).Parent = workspace
					slot.PetModel = model
				end
			end
			slot.PetUID = wantKey
		end
		local mm = math.floor(left / 60)
		local ss = left % 60
		local label = (pet and entry.PetId or "Pet") .. "\n" .. string.format("%02d:%02d", mm, ss)
		if ready then label = "READY TO HARVEST ✨" end
		slot.StatusText.Text = label
	end
end

local function nearRealm(): boolean
	local char = localPlayer.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - REALM_CENTER).Magnitude < 260
end

-- Butterflies: 3 tiny wanderers, only animate near realm.
local function ensureButterflies()
	local r = realm()
	if not r or #butterflies > 0 then return end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = "Butterfly" .. tostring(i)
		p.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.2, 0.4)
		p.Color = if i == 1 then Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220) elseif i == 2 then Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 150)
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Position = REALM_CENTER + Vector3.new(-10 + i * 8, 34, 10)
		p.Parent = r
		table.insert(butterflies, p)
	end
end

local elapsed = 0
Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not nearRealm() then return end
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < 1 / 30 then return end
	local delta = elapsed
	elapsed = 0
	local t = os.clock()
	for _, slot in pairs(slots) do
		local model = slot.PetModel
		if not model then continue end
		local pad = slot.Pad
		if not pad or not pad:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
		local seed = slot.Seed or 0
		local wander = Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 0.5 + seed) * 2.2, 0, math.cos(t * 0.4 + seed * 1.7) * 1.6)
		local hop = math.abs(math.sin(t * 2.2 + seed * 3)) * 0.35
		local bob = math.sin(t * 3 + seed) * 0.12
		local base = (pad :: BasePart).Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.6 + hop + bob, 0) + wander
		local faceAngle = math.sin(t * 0.3 + seed * 2) * 1.2
		local target = CFrame.new(base) * CFrame.Angles(0, faceAngle, math.sin(t * 1.4 + seed) * 0.06)
		local current = (model :: Model):GetPivot()
		if (current.Position - target.Position).Magnitude > 40 then
			(model :: Model):PivotTo(target)
		else
			(model :: Model):PivotTo(current:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-6 * delta)))
		end
	end
	for i, b in ipairs(butterflies) do
		local c = REALM_CENTER + Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 0.4 + i * 2.1) * 22, 4.5 + math.sin(t * 0.9 + i) * 1.2, math.cos(t * 0.33 + i * 1.3) * 22)
		b.Position = b.Position:Lerp(c, 1 - math.exp(-2 * delta))
	end
end)
